name: Morning brief
description: A tight brief each morning: decisions needed, then calendar, then FYIs.
instruction: Write my morning brief for today. Lead with anything that needs a decision from me today, then my calendar, then FYIs worth knowing. Keep it tight and skimmable.

name: Research new contacts
description: Builds a quick dossier on people new to my calendar or inbox.
instruction: For anyone new I'm meeting soon or who recently emailed, build a short dossier: who they are, their company, why we're talking, and one thing to open with.

name: Weekly review
description: Sunday look at the week ahead, protecting focus time.
instruction: Review my week ahead. Flag over-booked days, suggest where to cluster meetings, and protect my 9-11am focus blocks. Give me three concrete suggestions.

name: Draft replies
description: Watches for emails that clearly need a reply and drafts them in my voice.
instruction: When an email clearly needs a reply, draft one in my voice and queue it for my approval.
